The '''Ryloth Road''' was a secret [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] between the [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-producing [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and the spice-[[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] world of [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]]. It was mostly used by the [[Desilijic/Legends|Desilijic]] and [[Besadii/Legends|Besadii]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]], though a few other [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clans also possessed its [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] data.

==Astrography==
The Ryloth Road began at [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] and ended at [[Socorro/Legends|Socorro]].<ref name="LoNH" /> It intersected the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], the [[Corellian Skip Run]], the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]] and the [[Old Corellian Run]] at Ryloth, and [[Llanic Spice Run/Legends|Llanic Spice Run]] at Socorro.<ref name="TEA" /><ref name="LoNH" />
